description:
Seo E-rang is a two-year-old secretary to the vice president of Songhwa Construction, Han Jeong-wook. On Christmas Eve, she hears from her boss that he wants her to be his wife. "I need to get married, but I don't have time to find and love someone. And I don't want to play honeymoon. So I thought of you, my secretary. You know me better than anyone, so you won't interfere in my life and not even bother me." 

He doesn't love her, but he needs a wife out of convenience. She accepts the marriage contract, hoping he won't discover her secret. But soon she realizes that he is not as cold and indifferent as she thought. He cares about her, protects her and makes her feel special. Can she resist his charm and fulfill the contract? Or will she fall in love with him and risk everything?
